title: PostCompact output
description: No Claude Code decision control. Zed extension: append a passage to the stored summary. Top level open for Claude Code compatibility (same reason as hookSpecificOutput): unknown fields are ignored.

hookSpecificOutput.description: Event-specific output. Open for Claude Code compatibility: Claude Code adds fields here across versions, and a script shared with Claude Code must not be rejected by Zed for a field Zed does not know. Unknown fields are ignored.

hookEventName.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1064). Must be this event name; in Zed a mismatch is a hook failure.

zed.description: Zed extension. Passage appended to the summary.

append_to_summary.description: Text appended at the end of the stored summary; it becomes part of the conversation.
